items.title: Harden the stall detector from advisory to a blocking adjudication at the review-round mint site
items.context: core/review-convergence.ts already computes the stall/trend signal (STALL_MIN_ROUNDS=4, STALL_WINDOW=3 non-improving). handlers/transition-effects.ts:284-289 currently consumes it advisory-only inside a try/catch that never blocks — it only appends output text. Make the stall trigger REFUSE to mint another ordinary review round (block the REVIEW re-entry / new-round transition) until a structured resolution is recorded. Extend the existing detector; do not build a new one. The refusal must carry a structured prompt naming the allowed §3 actions.

happy.desc: a stalled REVIEW (>=STALL_MIN_ROUNDS with a non-improving trailing window) with no current-round resolution refuses to mint another ordinary review round, with a structured prompt naming the allowed actions

edge.desc: a converging trend (trailing-clean last==0 or strictly-decreasing blocker counts) at or beyond STALL_MIN_ROUNDS is NOT blocked — no false cap on a healthy story

adversarial.desc: the block cannot be bypassed by merely re-entering REVIEW / re-running reviewers without a recorded current-round resolution

items.title: Add the structured resolution actions that clear the stall block (incl. declare-checklist-item-unreachable)
items.context: On stall, require exactly ONE recorded action to clear the block: (a) human authorizes continuation with a reason + a bounded additional round budget; (b) the story is re-planned / split; (c) a root-cause / architecture escalation is recorded; (d) the blocking findings are explicitly resolved / disproven / deferred, or scope is shrunk; or (e) a checklist item is declared UNREACHABLE (the F-058 case a raw cap never surfaces — declaring it closes the loop instead of spinning). Provide the CLI command(s) + persisted, signed record consumed by the gate; the unreachable declaration must reconcile plan.md/claims (F-059) rather than leave them drifting.

happy.desc: recording any one of the five structured actions (bound to the current stalled round) clears the block so the next ordinary round mints

edge.desc: declaring a checklist item unreachable marks it withdrawn (B-1909 withdrawn-disposition semantics), reconciles plan/claims, and closes the loop instead of minting another round

adversarial.desc: an empty / previous-round / unsigned resolution does NOT clear the current-round block (no theater)

items.title: Add a hard ceiling / privileged override and prevent double-counting with the existing convergence-breaker and story_resume --ack
items.context: core/convergence-breaker.ts (maxAdvance=20, AUTO_RECOVERY_BUDGET=1, cleared by story_resume --ack) counts ADVANCES and is the only current brake; it never bit on review-round runaway. The new review-round adjudication must have a hard upper bound or a privileged override so it cannot be ignored indefinitely, and must NOT double-count review rounds against the convergence-breaker's advance count or conflict with the story_resume --ack recovery path. Verify both brakes coexist and each still fires on its own trigger.

happy.desc: a hard ceiling caps total ordinary review rounds even when resolutions are recorded, unless a privileged override with its own reason is recorded

edge.desc: the review-round stall adjudication and the advance-counting convergence-breaker coexist — each fires only on its own trigger (review rounds vs advances), no double-count

adversarial.desc: story_resume --ack clears the advance-counting breaker but does NOT clear the stall block, and recording a stall resolution does NOT touch the breaker advance baseline

items.title: RED-first smoke: reproduce the stall refusal and the F-058 unreachable-item scenario; register in validate
items.context: RED-first. (1) Drive a story to >= threshold non-improving completed review rounds and assert the Nth ordinary round is MINTED before the fix and REFUSED after, with the structured prompt. (2) Reproduce the F-058 scenario (a checklist item unreachable from the requirement) and assert that declaring it unreachable CLOSES the loop instead of spinning another round. (3) Assert the existing convergence-breaker + story_resume --ack still work and are not double-counted. Register the smoke in lattice.config.json validate.commands + package.json.

happy.desc: the registered smoke prints review-budget-stall-adjudication-smoke: PASS and is wired in lattice.config.json validate.commands + both package.json

edge.desc: RED-first: each assertion mutation-kills — reverting the block, the resolution-clear, the unreachable-close, or the breaker coexistence makes the smoke fail

adversarial.desc: the smoke drives the REAL gate/handler entry points (not reimplemented logic), reproducing the stall refusal, the F-058 unreachable-item loop closure, and convergence-breaker non-interference
